maddeler.e:
يجلعب (form IVq)
# يَجْلَعِبُّ (yajlaʕibbu) /jad͡ʒ.la.ʕib.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
# يُجْلَعَبُّ (yujlaʕabbu) /jud͡ʒ.la.ʕab.bu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِجْلَعَبَّ (ijlaʕabba)
# يَجْلَعِبَّ (yajlaʕibba) /jad͡ʒ.la.ʕib.ba/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of ا
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
